analysis.headline: Summary claims consent to record anxiety, but the customer refused it (T10); it also states the arrears amount and omits that the customer has no money for food.

claims.explanation: Name, DOB and address/postcode were given and verified.

evidence.quote: those details are verified

claims.explanation: Agent opened with a general greeting and the customer explained their query.

evidence.quote: How can I help today?

claims.explanation: The arrears amount was stated, which the rules forbid; only 'arrears were discussed' is allowed.

evidence.quote: arrears of four hundred and sixty pounds

claims.text: The customer’s partner left taking all joint savings, their zero-hour warehouse contract provided no shifts this week, and they reported anxiety;
claims.explanation: Partner leaving with the savings, zero-hours contract, no shifts this week and anxiety were all stated. The warehouse mention is a generic workplace description rather than a named entity.

evidence.quote: He took the money from our joint savings, all of it.
Two last week, none this week.

claims.explanation: The customer explicitly declined to have the health information recorded and the agent agreed not to record it.

evidence.quote: I'd rather you didn't write the health bit down.
I won't record that health information.

claims.text: The I&E assessment was deferred until the rota is available,
claims.explanation: I&E was postponed until the customer has their rota.

evidence.quote: Can we do it when I've got the rota?
Yes, we can do it then.

claims.text: the agent explained possible credit file impact,
claims.explanation: The agent said the hold cannot be promised to prevent credit file impact.

evidence.quote: I can't promise it will prevent any credit file impact.

claims.text: and the customer was referred to Citizens Advice and customer signposted to the company website for support,
claims.explanation: Citizens Advice and the company website support page were both suggested, and the required phrase is used.

evidence.quote: Citizens Advice can help with your money situation
Our company website also has a support page

claims.text: with the agent checking the customer’s understanding.
claims.explanation: The agent asked 'Would those be useful?' and later confirmed the plan, but there was no explicit understanding check.

evidence.quote: Would those be useful?
That's right.

claims.text: A thirty-day hold on collection contact was applied,
claims.explanation: The agent confirmed the thirty-day hold was applied.

evidence.quote: I've applied the thirty-day hold.

claims.text: and the next steps are to seek advice before the company calls on 4 November to review the position and complete the I&E assessment.
claims.explanation: The call on the fourth of November is to review the position and complete I&E.

evidence.quote: we'll call on the fourth of November to review the position
How can I help today?
those details are verified
two missed instalments

omissions.title: Severe hardship (no money for food) omitted
omissions.detail: The customer said they have no money for food and rely on their sister for shopping. The rules require severe hardship to be stated specifically.
omissions.suggested_wording: Customer stated they have no money for food.

evidence.quote: I've got no money for food just now.

omissions.title: Customer declined to have vulnerability recorded
omissions.detail: The customer asked that the health information not be recorded and the agent agreed. The summary should reflect this instead of claiming consent.
omissions.suggested_wording: Customer declined consent to record the health vulnerability.

evidence.quote: I'd rather you didn't write the health bit down.
